name: TARX public-safe context tools
privacy: Remote MCP is public-safe and auth-bounded. Do not send Vault data, files, credentials, API keys, tokens, or raw secrets to remote models. Private files, protected secrets, device context, and local-only memory require an installed TARX local runtime, authentication, and explicit permission.
route_truth: Computer by default; Supercomputer only with explicit approval and entitlement.

function.name: tarx_status
function.description: Check the approved TARX MCP boundary for this session. Remote MCP returns public-safe/auth-bounded status only; local files, secrets, and device context require a local TARX runtime and explicit permission.

function.name: tarx_memory_store
function.description: Store user-approved account-scoped context such as decisions, preferences, and project notes. Do not store passwords, API keys, tokens, files, or raw secrets here; those require TARX Vault/local permissioned workflows.

function.name: tarx_memory_search
function.description: Search approved account-scoped TARX work context for this authenticated session. Remote MCP cannot read local private files, protected secrets, device context, or unauthenticated local memory.

function.name: tarx_context
function.description: Load a compact TARX operating context brief with route-truth, approved memory boundaries, and session guidance. Missing local/private context must be reported honestly.

query.description: Optional memory query to seed context
